description: This file defines the class `S3EncryptionMultipartUploader`, which manages the multipart upload of encrypted objects to Amazon S3, including handling encryption parameters, preparation of data, and upload configuration.

classes.name: S3EncryptionMultipartUploader
classes.description: A class responsible for executing multipart uploads of encrypted objects to Amazon S3, supporting encryption workflows, and configurable strategies for metadata management.

methods.name: isSupportedCipher
methods.description: Checks if a given cipher name is supported for encryption by the SDK.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the multipart uploader with encryption parameters, client, source, and configuration options, setting up encryption and upload metadata.

methods.name: getDefaultStrategy
methods.description: Provides the default metadata strategy for storing encryption envelope information, which is used during multipart upload.

methods.name: getEncryptingDataPreparer
methods.description: Returns a closure that defers the encryption work until the upload is performed, preparing encrypted data and related parameters for the upload process.
